summary: Iteration 3 frontend testing (client-side app, no backend). Verified all 4 new features: mode toggle (single/batch), PII Heatmap (11 cells + click-to-scroll), Presets (save/apply/persist across reload/delete), and HMAC-SHA-256 Signed Records (signed & unsigned paths, 64-hex signature_hex, valid signature block fields). Batch mode verified: 2 files added via batch-file-input, per-item heatmap + PII pills + per-column transform selects rendered, batch-apply produced /redactorium-batch-\d+\.zip/ containing MANIFEST.json with signed:true and per-file redactorium-log.json signed with HMAC-SHA-256. Regression: single-file sample flow, apply transformations, JSON/PDF/ZIP downloads all work. No JS errors on any flow.

issues: React hydration warning: <button data-testid='batch-remove-item'> is nested inside the outer expand/collapse <button> in BatchItem (BatchView.jsx lines 261-283). This produces a console warning: 'In HTML, <button> cannot be a descendant of <button>'. Functionally works (click stopPropagation) but should be refactored — e.g., make the outer container a div with role=button, or move the remove button outside the collapse button.

action_items: Fix nested <button> in BatchView.jsx (BatchItem): move data-testid='batch-remove-item' outside the outer collapse <button> or convert the outer to a div/summary element to eliminate React hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: BatchView.jsx: nested button element (hydration warning). Minor a11y/HTML validity issue.
signing.js: key_fingerprint_sha256 is truncated to first 16 hex chars (8 bytes) — acceptable as fingerprint but worth documenting in the JSON log schema.

Redactorium.jsx sig-key-input lives only in ActionBar (single mode). In batch mode the input is not rendered, so users must set the signing key in single mode BEFORE switching to batch (state is preserved via sigKey prop). This works but is non-obvious UX; consider surfacing sig-key-input in batch view too.
seed_data_creation: None persisted; test presets were created in localStorage and cleaned up (deleted) at end of test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 features all pass. If iteration 4 is added, sample data has 11 columns (headers exposed as data-testid='transform-select-<i>' in single mode and data-testid='batch-transform-<itemId>-<i>' in batch). Signing key input only in single-mode ActionBar; state carries over to batch when toggling. Preset chips use data-testid='preset-<8char-id>' with apply-preset-<id> and delete-preset-<id>. localStorage key: 'redactorium.presets.v1'.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Single minor code-quality issue (nested <button>) noted.
